description: Use operation=query with the provider taskId returned by create. Query is sent to the API's /aigc/textTaskQuery endpoint; the system task-result endpoint is not used.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Product-copy generation instruction; required by create.
fields.example: Write a product description for a wireless speaker.

fields.name: imageUrls
fields.description: Media URLs used as context. Pass an empty array for text-only generation; use up to 10 images or typically one video.

fields.name: thinkingLevel
fields.description: Reasoning level required by create. GEM_3_1_PRO does not support minimal.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Text-generation model. GEM_3_FLASH is the default.

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Optional provider member identifier used by create and query.

fields.name: taskId
fields.description: Provider task ID returned by create; required by operation=query.

example.prompt: Write a product description for a wireless speaker.
